name: Rokae (Shandong) Robotics Group Inc. Class H
summary: Rokae (Shandong) Robotics Group Inc. designs, develops, manufactures and commercialises intelligent robots and robotic solutions in China. It offers a robotic application ecosystem of industrial robots, flexible collaborative robots and embodied intelligent robots, built on the ROKAE technology platform including a forward design and validation system and the xCore control system.
